items.headline: Tiger Woods' Kind Call
items.text: Tiger Woods personally called Kim Galvin as she battled rare cancer, a gesture credited by Dottie Pepper with extending Galvin's life by six months.

items.headline: Nelly Korda's Major Streak
items.text: Nelly Korda became the first player since Inbee Park in 2013 to win the first two majors of the calendar year, signaling a potentially historic season for her.
